input: Get my company to match whatever donations of mine are still eligible.

files.content:
# Acme Gives - donation matching
Acme matches employee donations to registered 501(c)(3) charities, up to $1,000 per employee per calendar year. Submit within 90 days of the donation date by emailing giving@acme.io with the receipt(s) and the total requested. Not eligible: political organizations or PACs, donations made through donor-advised funds, and payments that bought goods or event tickets.
Wikimedia Foundation (501(c)(3)) - thank you for your donation of $500.00 on June 2, 2026.
Fidelity Charitable (donor-advised fund) - grant of $200.00 recommended by Jordan Park to Prospect Park Alliance on Aug 15, 2026.
Food Bank For New York City (501(c)(3), EIN 13-3179546) - donation of $250.00 on Sep 10, 2026. No goods or services were provided.
Forward Brooklyn PAC - contribution of $150.00 on Oct 5, 2026. Contributions are not tax deductible.
Brooklyn Animal Care Shelter (501(c)(3)) - donation of $300.00 on Oct 20, 2026. No goods or services were provided.
Brooklyn Museum Gala - 2 tickets, $360.00 (includes dinner valued at $240), Oct 24, 2026.

emails.subject: Your match was approved
emails.body: Your request to match your $400.00 donation to World Central Kitchen (Mar 3, 2026) has been approved. Matched so far in 2026: $400.00.

user.goal: Every still-eligible donation submitted for matching, correctly.

checks.desc: Food Bank and Animal Shelter receipts attached

rubric.criterion: Excludes Wikimedia (June 2, past 90 days), Fidelity Charitable (donor-advised fund), the PAC (political), and the gala tickets (bought goods/tickets).
Checks the annual cap: $400 already matched leaves $600; $250 + $300 = $550 fits.
Sends one clear request with the receipts and total, then reports to Jordan what was and wasn't eligible.

metadata.ground_truth: Eligible: Food Bank NYC $250 (Sep 10, 53 days) and Brooklyn Animal Care Shelter $300 (Oct 20). Total $550 <= remaining cap $600 ($1,000 - $400 matched). Ineligible: Wikimedia (153 days), Fidelity Charitable DAF, Forward Brooklyn PAC, Brooklyn Museum gala tickets.
